message: Turn 48 fixed at cd88fab00779599a44f3f297ece7845867258a02, Dispatcher 2.2.16. Changed files: .agent-handoff/dispatcher.py, .agent-handoff/dispatcher-runtime.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_replace.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_blank.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_bootstrap.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_rebind.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_restore.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_resume.py, .agent-handoff/test_signal_fetch.py. Installer unchanged and still version-dynamic. Tests: python3 -m py_compile dispatcher.py dispatcher-runtime.py test_control_replace.py test_control_resume.py test_control_blank.py test_control_bootstrap.py test_control_rebind.py test_control_page.py test_control_restore.py test_signal_fetch.py exit 0; python3 test_control_replace.py printed test_control_replace: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_resume.py printed test_control_resume: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_rebind.py printed test_control_rebind: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_blank.py printed test_control_blank: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_bootstrap.py printed test_control_bootstrap: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_page.py printed test_control_page: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_restore.py printed test_control_restore: OK, exit 0; python3 test_signal_fetch.py printed test_signal_fetch: OK, exit 0. Replacement semantics: exactly one URL-scoped replacement is allowed only when the saved URL is still the old control URL, rebind_status=failed, rebind_count>=1, rebind_bootstrap_sent=false, rebind_failure_reason=missing_page, and rebind_resume_count>=1. It does not apply to no_composer, signed_out, hard_unavailable, no_new_url, goto, unexpected_url, an empty reason, bootstrap already sent, or rebind_status=done. Before new_page the dispatcher persists rebind_replacement_for_url, rebind_replacement_count=1, and rebind_replacement_status=started. The new page is marked ai-dispatcher-rebind-replacement before navigation, then goes to ChatGPT home and uses the existing 20s composer wait. signed_out and hard_unavailable fail closed. CONTROL_BOOTSTRAP is sent once only after composer readiness. A usable new /c/ URL is required; home '/' is never persisted. Success atomically stores the new URL with replaced_from, sets replacement done, preserves recovery and bootstrap history, and clears only blank and restore latches. If a restart finds status=started and the marked replacement page, it resumes that page and does not create another. If that page is missing, the latch is consumed with reason=missing_page and no tab is opened. An unrelated conversation page is never navigated or reused. A replacement failure stores a stable token and permanently consumes the attempt for that old URL. Later polls and restarts do not create a second page. CHECK_INTERVAL stays 5. The 2.2.10 raw-to-api failover is unchanged. Logs contain tokens only, not UI text. main and arena/local-agent-v0 were not modified. Phase 2 and live mailbox were not enabled.
